poo_landlord.text: Welcome to the Poole Arms. This pub's been on the Quay for well over two hundred years, and we've fed a good many sailors who'd just come in from Newfoundland. We still have plenty of fish.
We do a crab sandwich that will change your life. Or at least stop it feeling quite so long until teatime.

poo_quiz.text: Quiz night's tonight, if you fancy it. Warm-up question: which island in Poole Harbour did the Scouts begin on? Brownsea! Not hard, to be fair.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Fair enough. The offer stands, and so does the bar.

poole_pub_shanty.text: Poole's quay has seen more ropes than a rigger's shed, and the old shantyman here knows every song that hauled them. Care to join in? Pull when the line lights up.
